title: SM64DS Co-op 0.5.6 preview 2 — dialogue controls and multi-file mods

additional_checks: native and custom File A displays

notes:
Fixes **Enter/Start opening Pause over native dialogue**, including locked-door text. The game now lets its text and save prompts own confirmation input; Enter, Escape and controller Start advance dialogue. The normal adventure pause menu remains available after text closes.

**Multi-file DS Lua mods:** put `main.lua` and other `.lua` files in one mod folder. The main file runs first, then the others alphabetically, sharing a sandbox and globals. Up to 32 scripts totalling 1 MiB; one script failing disables the whole mod. Single Lua files, enable/disable selections, SM64 Movement and texture pack tools remain available. Extract mod ZIP downloads manually. Gameplay Lua currently runs only in solo adventure; CoopDX scripts need adapting to the [DS API](https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/blob/dd14d6bef1040b82c4d2ea74e65c532630f50343/port/docs/ds-lua-api.md).

Open `sm64ds coop.exe` directly. Retain your own game data, saves, settings and edited mods when updating. This ZIP contains the EXE, documents, the editable movement mod and portable mod/texture folders. It contains no cartridge assets, original music, textures or player saves.

Validation on source `dd14d6bef1040b82c4d2ea74e65c532630f50343`: a full Windows build with DS-state, face-cycle and ARM9-global guards; seven native dialogue/controller-input/pause regressions; an actual-game multi-file Lua hook test; save-file displays and the installed EXE's default data path. Eleven portable component checks passed, with additional Lua file-count/combined-size/Unicode/error-isolation checks. The scripted controller path was tested, not a physical controller device. A reproducible [dialogue check](https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/blob/dd14d6bef1040b82c4d2ea74e65c532630f50343/port/tools/check_dialogue_controls.py) requires your own local assets.

This is a **Windows x86 preview**. Playable Linux/SteamOS, macOS, Android and iOS apps and public lobby browsing remain unfinished. See [native port work](https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/pull/8) and [website work](https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/pull/9). The earlier preview contains the camera, music/background and texture-creation changes; this update focuses on dialogue and Lua loading.
